assets.description: Turn a video clip into a training-ready asset package. Existing projects load their preparation state automatically.
assets.source_description: Choose where to save the project, then add the source face video for asset preparation.
assets.steps_description: Complete the four preparation steps. Before locking, you can reprocess existing artifacts.
assets.ready_description: Continue to model training for the next step.
assets.package_description: Review the asset package summary and verify that project files are complete
assets.normalize_hint: Normalize video frame rate and audio to prepare for image and feature extraction.
assets.frames_hint: Extract frames, detect faces, and save landmarks and image-quality data.
assets.features_hint: Extract features from the project audio for training and mouth-shape generation.
assets.lock_hint: Verify preparation artifacts and lock the asset package for training and generation.

training.description: Choose a training method and train a model for video generation with the locked asset package.
training.form_description: Choose a preset, then configure the network, training epochs, and batch size.
training.fast_hint: Start with baseline training to validate the assets and overall result.
training.mouth_hint: Build on baseline training with additional mouth-detail constraints.
training.temporal_hint: Build on mouth-enhanced training with constraints on neighboring-frame changes.
training.epochs_hint: Enter the final training epoch (1–10000). Resume above the completed checkpoint epoch.
training.resume_hint: Resume reads the latest project checkpoint; turning it off starts from fresh weights
training.monitoring_description: Live progress comes from task events; saved metrics come from the latest training record
training.metrics_empty: No saved metrics have been loaded yet. Refresh the record after a training epoch completes.
training.details_description: View training parameters and complete metrics for the selected preset and checkpoint.
training.metrics_details_hint: Values come from the saved metrics file; remaining time is the estimate recorded at that moment

generate.description: Generate video from a training checkpoint and locked asset package, with short previews available first.
generate.form_description: Confirm the model checkpoint and audio track, then choose output scope and location.
generate.audio_project: Use the audio track from project assets.
generate.audio_picked: Use the manually selected audio track.
generate.audio_unset: Select an audio track or finish media processing on the Assets page first.
generate.preview_description: Generate only the opening clip to check the overall result first
generate.full_description: Use all available frames in the asset package
generate.latest_task: Show the actual status of the latest generation task.
generate.format_description: Resolution is fixed by the asset package; frame rate and codecs use fixed settings
generate.renders_description: Show outputs in the project directory and completed session renders, up to 8 items.
generate.renders_empty: Completed videos appear here for playback or opening their containing folder.
